literature_notes: MARVELD3 is a four-pass transmembrane MARVEL-domain protein. Its topology places the long N-terminal domain (residues 1–199) and the short C-terminal tail (residues 383–401) entirely on the intracellular face, with two extracellular loops: ECL1 (221–271, 51 aa) and ECL2 (326–360, 35 aa). Every ledger line (L1–L7) reports a tag at either the N-terminus (HA, EGFP, BirA: L1, L2, L5, L6, L7) or the C-terminus (VSV, BirA: L3, L4, L7). Both termini are intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so none of these constructs places a tag on the extracellular face. No ledger line reports any insertion — epitope tag, fluorescent protein, transposon, or otherwise — within ECL1 or ECL2. Because the rules require every site to be grounded in one ledger line reporting a tolerated insertion at that extracellular position, and no such line exists, the correct answer is zero surface tag sites.
